name: Diffuser opaque inspection surrogate

original_specification.name: Diffuser opaque inspection surrogate
original_specification.purpose: An opaque inspection stand-in for a light-diffuser sheet.

baseline_projection.value_basis: Original, unmeasured preview choices; no grade-specific optical constants.
baseline_projection.fidelity: Uniform opaque response only; detailed target behavior is not encoded.

advanced_target.optical_model: Transmissive dielectric with volume scattering or explicitly modeled embossing; those mechanisms remain separate.

authoring_controls.meaning: Authored geometric relief, not a scattering coefficient.

geometry_and_mapping_requirements: Choose a volume-scatter target or an embossed-surface target explicitly
Keep physical sheet thickness in CAD
unknown_optical_inputs: Angular response of a selected diffuser
validation_criteria: The baseline must not make an enclosed light appear functional
Normal-map frosting alone must not be claimed as volume diffusion

scope: Exact original opaque baseline; advanced source intent remains explicit.
